instruction: Browse Batman action figures for kids and sort by highest price.

metadata.explanation: Task requires browsing Batman action figures in Kids category and sorting by price high-low (S=5). Same 3-step navigation complexity as original. Uses existing evaluator components without custom code.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three task requirements: Batman category, Action Figures for Kids, and Price High-Low sorting
Uses multi-pronged verification approach with both HTML content extraction (breadcrumbs, sort selector) and URL parameter checking
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse) can extract HTML elements by class names and parse URL parameters appropriately
Metric logic (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares extracted values against expected values
Website-specific brittleness: relies on kohls.com-specific class names (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector) which may change
URL parameter mapping (S=5 → Price High-Low) is hardcoded and website-specific, reducing robustness
No postconfig to refresh page state, but this is acceptable as failure to extract would correctly indicate incomplete task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fallback verification methods if class names change (e.g., checking multiple possible selectors)
Add more flexible URL parameter detection instead of hardcoding S=5
Consider adding postconfig to reopen the page or refresh state to ensure verification reliability
Document the website-specific dependencies so maintainers know which parts may break if website changes
